title: Inner Pot Missing
fullDescription: Foodi senses inner pot missing or not seated.

title: Wrong Lid
fullDescription: Foodi has two lids — pressure and air-crisp. Selected function requires different lid.

fixSteps.title: Switch lid
fixSteps.instruction: Use pressure lid for pressure cook, attached lid for air crisp.

title: Pressure Lid Open
fullDescription: Pressure lid not turned to lock position.

title: Vent Position Wrong
fullDescription: Pressure release valve set to VENT instead of SEAL for pressure cook.

title: Insufficient Liquid
fullDescription: Foodi requires minimum 1 cup liquid to build pressure.

title: Food Burning
fullDescription: Foodi detected burn risk — food sticking to pot.

faq.a: Yes, don't stir thick sauce in.

title: Sensor Disconnect
fullDescription: Temp sensor in heating plate disconnected.

title: Heating Element Fault
fullDescription: Heating element open circuit or thermostat trip.

title: Air Crisp Element Fault
fullDescription: Air-crisp element in attached lid failed.

title: Won't Pressurize
fullDescription: Steam escaping past silicone gasket or float valve.

fixSteps.title: Reseat ring
fixSteps.instruction: Press silicone gasket fully into lid.

whenToCallPro: If gasket new and still leaks.

title: Pot not detected
shortDescription: Inner pot missing or sensor fault.
fullDescription: Inner pot missing or sensor fault. This is a common diagnostic indication on Ninja pressure cookers. Most issues can be resolved with cleaning, reset, or part replacement following the brand's service procedure.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug pressure cooker for 60 seconds, then plug back in.

fixSteps.title: Clean
fixSteps.instruction: Clean any sensors/contacts indicated by the brand's manual.

fixSteps.title: Test
fixSteps.instruction: Run a normal cycle and verify error does not return.

whenToCallPro: If problem persists after cleaning and reset, professional service may be needed.

faq.a: Resolve the error first to avoid worsening the issue.
If under warranty, contact manufacturer before DIY repair.
